(* --- 3.1 Slag Liquidus Temperature & Urbain Optical Basicity Viscosity Model --- *)
(* Slag system: SiO2 - Al2O3 - CaO - MgO - FeOx *)
(* Absolute temperature conversion *)
rSlagTempKelvin := rSlagTemp_Filt_C + 273.15;

(* Optical Basicity calculation: Lambda = Sum(x_i * Lambda_i) *)
(* Elemental basicities: CaO=1.00, MgO=0.78, Al2O3=0.60, SiO2=0.48, FeO=0.93 *)
rOpticalBasicity := (0.01 * rSlagBasicity_B2 * rSiO2_wt_pct * 1.00) +
                    (0.01 * rMgO_wt_pct * 0.78) +
                    (0.01 * rAl2O3_wt_pct * 0.60) +
                    (0.01 * rSiO2_wt_pct * 0.48) +
                    (0.01 * rFeTotal_wt_pct * 0.93);

(* Non-Bridging Oxygen per Tetrahedrally Coordinated Cation: NBO/T *)
(* NBO/T = 2 * (x_CaO + x_MgO + x_FeO - x_Al2O3) / (x_SiO2 + 2*x_Al2O3) *)
rTmpA := (rSlagBasicity_B2 * rSiO2_wt_pct) + rMgO_wt_pct + rFeTotal_wt_pct - rAl2O3_wt_pct;
rTmpB := rSiO2_wt_pct + (2.0 * rAl2O3_wt_pct);
IF rTmpB > 5.0 THEN
    rNonBridgingOxygenRatio := 2.0 * rTmpA / rTmpB;
ELSE
    rNonBridgingOxygenRatio := 1.80;
END_IF;

(* Slag Liquidus Temperature Empirical Estimation based on Phase Equilibrium *)
rEstimatedSlagLiquidus_C := 1420.0 + (35.0 * rAl2O3_wt_pct / 15.0) + (18.0 * (rSlagBasicity_B2 - 0.85) * 50.0) - (12.0 * rFeTotal_wt_pct);
IF rEstimatedSlagLiquidus_C < 1380.0 THEN
    rEstimatedSlagLiquidus_C := 1380.0;
ELSIF rEstimatedSlagLiquidus_C > 1560.0 THEN
    rEstimatedSlagLiquidus_C := 1560.0;
END_IF;

(* Urbain / Weymann-Frenkel Viscosity Calculation: mu = A * T * exp(1000 * B / T) *)
(* Parameters A and B are mapped as polynomials of optical basicity and silica fraction *)
rUrbain_Param_B := 6200.0 + (5500.0 * (1.0 - rOpticalBasicity)) + (1200.0 / (rNonBridgingOxygenRatio + 0.1));
rUrbain_Param_A := 0.00018 * EXP(-0.00025 * rUrbain_Param_B);

IF rSlagTempKelvin > 1400.0 THEN
    rEstimatedSlagViscosity_Pa_s := rUrbain_Param_A * rSlagTempKelvin * EXP(rUrbain_Param_B / rSlagTempKelvin);
ELSE
    rEstimatedSlagViscosity_Pa_s := 2.50; (* Massive freeze skull viscosity *)
END_IF;

(* Check Slag Superheat Margin above Liquidus *)
IF (rSlagTemp_Filt_C - rEstimatedSlagLiquidus_C) < c_rMinLiquidusMargin THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_4000; (* Slag Skull Freeze Threat Warning *)
END_IF;

(* --- 3.2 High-Frequency Induction Heating (HFIH) Skin Effect & Joule Dissipation --- *)
(* Inverter tank angular frequency: omega = 2 * pi * f *)
rAngularFreq_rads := 2.0 * 3.14159265 * (rInductionFreqFeedback_kHz * 1000.0);

(* Slag High-Frequency Electromagnetic Skin Depth: delta = sqrt( 2 / (omega * mu_0 * sigma) ) *)
IF (rSlagConductivity_Sm > 5.0) AND (rAngularFreq_rads > 1000.0) THEN
    rSkinDepth_m := SQRT(2.0 / (rAngularFreq_rads * c_rPermeabilityVacuum * rSlagConductivity_Sm));
    rSkinDepth_Induction_mm := rSkinDepth_m * 1000.0;
ELSE
    rSkinDepth_Induction_mm := 15.0;
END_IF;

(* Crucible steady-state conductive and surface radiation thermal dissipation [kW] *)
(* Radiation P_rad = epsilon * sigma_SB * A * (T^4 - T_amb^4) *)
rTmpA := rSlagTempKelvin / 1000.0;
rEffectiveSlagThermalLoss_kW := 280.0 + (38.5 * (rTmpA * rTmpA * rTmpA * rTmpA));

(* --- 3.3 Iridium-Based Inert Anode OER Kinetics & Butler-Volmer Overpotential --- *)
(* Anodic reaction: 2 O^(2-) -> O2(g) + 4 e- *)
(* Anode superficial current density: j = I_cell / A_anode *)
IF c_rAnodeEffectiveArea > 0.1 THEN
    rAnodeCurrentDensity_A_m2 := (rCellCurrent_Filt_kA * 1000.0) / c_rAnodeEffectiveArea;
ELSE
    rAnodeCurrentDensity_A_m2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Nernst Reversible Decomposition Potential at 1600°C for Fe2O3 -> 2 Fe + 1.5 O2 *)
(* E_rev(T) = Delta_G0 / (n*F) + (R*T / (n*F)) * ln( a_Fe^2 * p_O2^1.5 / a_Fe2O3 ) *)
(* Baseline E_rev ~ 1.285 V at 1600°C with p_O2 = 1.0 atm, FeOx activity proxy *)
IF rFeTotal_wt_pct > 0.1 THEN
    rCalculatedNernstPotential_V := 1.285 + ((c_rGasConstR * rSlagTempKelvin) / (6.0 * c_rFaradayConst)) * LN(10.0 / rFeTotal_wt_pct);
ELSE
    rCalculatedNernstPotential_V := 1.450;
END_IF;

(* Bulk Electrolyte Ohmic (IR) Drop: V_IR = I * R_slag = I * (d_gap / (sigma * A_c)) *)
IF (rSlagConductivity_Sm > 10.0) AND (c_rHearthArea > 1.0) THEN
    rCalculatedOhmicDrop_V := (rCellCurrent_Filt_kA * 1000.0) * (c_rInterElectrodeGap / (rSlagConductivity_Sm * c_rHearthArea));
ELSE
    rCalculatedOhmicDrop_V := 0.50;
END_IF;

(* Tafel Slope: b = 2.302585 * R * T / (alpha_a * z * F) with z = 4 for OER *)
rTafelSlope_V_dec := (2.302585 * c_rGasConstR * rSlagTempKelvin) / (rAnodicTransferCoeff_alpha * 4.0 * c_rFaradayConst);

(* Butler-Volmer High-Field Kinetic Overpotential Approximation: *)
(* eta_OER = b * log10( j / j0 ) *)
IF (rAnodeCurrentDensity_A_m2 > 10.0) AND (rExchangeCurrentDensity_j0 > 1.0) THEN
    rTmpA := rAnodeCurrentDensity_A_m2 / rExchangeCurrentDensity_j0;
    IF rTmpA > 1.0 THEN
        rCalculatedOER_Overpotential_V := rTafelSlope_V_dec * (LN(rTmpA) / 2.302585);
    ELSE
        rCalculatedOER_Overpotential_V := 0.050;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCalculatedOER_Overpotential_V := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Iridium Inert Anode Surface Wear / Dissolution Rate in nm/h *)
(* r_wear = k0 * exp(-Ea / RT) * (1 + beta * eta^2) *)
rTmpA := rCalculatedOER_Overpotential_V / c_rMaxOEROverpotential;
rIridiumAnodeWearRate_nm_h := (2.50 * EXP((rSlagTemp_Filt_C - 1600.0) / 45.0)) * (1.0 + (3.2 * (rTmpA * rTmpA)));

(* Passivity Breakdown Warning Debounce *)

(* --- 3.4 Cathodic Iron Direct Reduction & Mass Balance --- *)

(* For Fe(III) + 3e- -> Fe: z = 3 *)

rTheoreticalO2Flow_Nm3h := (rCellCurrent_Filt_kA * 1000.0 * (rFaradaicEfficiency_pct / 100.0) * c_rStdO2MolarVolume * 3600.0) /

                   (Bd_22 * rMPC_Q_FeOx * x2_Next) +

                   (Bd_42 * rMPC_Q_Overpot * x4_Next) +

    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 AND 16#FFFE_FFFF;
END_IF;

(* Slag High Viscosity Impairing Gas Detachment *)
IF rEstimatedSlagViscosity_Pa_s > 0.650 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0002_0000; (* High Slag Viscosity *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 AND 16#FFFD_FFFF;
END_IF;

(* Hearth Liquid Metal Overflow Risk *)
IF rIronLevel_Filt_mm > c_rMaxSiphonPoolLevel THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0800; (* Liquid Metal Hearth Full Trip *)
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Refractory Thermomechanical Fatigue Advisory *)
IF rVotedRefractoryStrain > 850.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0004_0000; (* Refractory High Strain Warning *)
    bWarningActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Bitpack System Status Word *)
dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0000;
IF bSystemReady THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0001; END_IF;
IF bSystemRunning THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0002; END_IF;
IF bSystemTrip THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0004; END_IF;
IF bDegraded_1oo2_Mode THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0008; END_IF;
IF bDegraded_InductionOnly THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0010; END_IF;
IF (rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct > 0.1) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0020; END_IF;
IF (rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA > 10.0) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0040; END_IF;
IF (rInductionPowerDemand_kW > 100.0) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0080; END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.0 MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT                           *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
       (* STATE 0: IDLE / COLD STANDBY                                                       *)
       (* System de-energized, waiting for master enable and safety interlocks OK           *)
       (* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'IDLE / COLD STANDBY';
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := 0.0;
        rInductionPowerDemand_kW := 0.0;
        rOreFeederDemand_kgh := 0.0;
        rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct := 0.0;
        rSiphonArgonLift_Nm3h := 0.0;
        rAnodePositionDemand_mm := 0.0; (* Retracted fully *)

        IF bAcknowledgeFault THEN
            bSystemTrip := FALSE;
            dwAlarmWord_1 := 16#0000_0000;
            dwAlarmWord_2 := 16#0000_0000;
        END_IF;

        bSystemReady := (NOT bSystemTrip) AND bEmergencyStop AND bInductionMasterEnable AND bAnodePositionCalibrated;

        IF bEnableSystem AND bSystemReady THEN
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 10: HIGH-FREQUENCY INDUCTION PREHEAT & SUSCEPTOR COUPLING                  *)
        (* Heats crucible and molten oxide slag above liquidus (~1550°C)                    *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'INDUCTION PREHEAT & MELT';
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;

        (* Ramp Induction Heating Power *)
        IF rInductionPowerDemand_kW < 3200.0 THEN
            rInductionPowerDemand_kW := rInductionPowerDemand_kW + (25.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        END_IF;

        rAnodePositionDemand_mm := 0.0; (* Anode remains raised in purge hood *)
        rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := 0.0;
        rOreFeederDemand_kgh := 0.0;

        (* Check Slag Liquefaction and Superheat Margin *)
        tonPreheatSoakTimer(IN := (rSlagTemp_Filt_C >= 1550.0) AND (rEstimatedSlagViscosity_Pa_s < 0.450), PT := T#30S);
        IF tonPreheatSoakTimer.Q THEN
            tonPreheatSoakTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 20: ANODE SUBMERGENCE & ARGON HEADSPACE PURGE                              *)
        (* Lowers iridium inert anode into molten slag and flushes oxygen headspace with Ar  *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'ANODE IMMERSION & PURGE';

        (* Maintain Slag Superheat via Induction *)
        rInductionPowerDemand_kW := rEffectiveSlagThermalLoss_kW * 1.15;

        (* Smoothly lower anode to target immersion depth (150 mm) *)
        IF rAnodePositionDemand_mm < 150.0 THEN
            rAnodePositionDemand_mm := rAnodePositionDemand_mm + (10.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        ELSE
            rAnodePositionDemand_mm := 150.0;
        END_IF;

        tonAnodeSubmergeDelay(IN := (rAnodeImmersionDepthFeedback_mm >= 145.0), PT := T#15S);
        IF tonAnodeSubmergeDelay.Q THEN
            tonAnodeSubmergeDelay(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 30;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 30: RECTIFIER VOLTAGE STRIKE & OER INITIATION                              *)
        (* Applies polarization potential, strikes electrolytic OER, verifies gas evolution *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'VOLTAGE STRIKE & OER RAMP';

        (* Ramp Rectifier Current gently at 2.0 kA/s to establish OER *)
        IF rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA < 45.0 THEN
            rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA + (2.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        END_IF;

        tonStrikeRampTimer(IN := (rVotedCellVoltage_V > 2.20) AND (rVotedOxygenFlow_Nm3h > 50.0), PT := T#10S);
        IF tonStrikeRampTimer.Q THEN
            tonStrikeRampTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 40;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 40: FULL CONTINUOUS PRODUCTION REDUCTION (CLOSED-LOOP MPC ACTIVE)          *)
        (* Regulates DC current, induction trim, ore feed, and electrode immersion           *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'FULL CLOSED-LOOP MOE RUN';

        (* Apply MPC Optimal Increments *)
        rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA + (rDeltaCurrent_Cmd * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        rInductionPowerDemand_kW   := rInductionPowerDemand_kW + (rDeltaInduction_Cmd * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        rOreFeederDemand_kgh       := rOreFeederDemand_kgh + (rDeltaOre_Cmd * c_rScanTimeSeconds);

        (* Bound Checks for Production Actuators *)
        IF rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA > 250.0 THEN rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := 250.0; END_IF;
        IF rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA < 20.0 THEN rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := 20.0; END_IF;

        IF rInductionPowerDemand_kW > 4200.0 THEN rInductionPowerDemand_kW := 4200.0; END_IF;
        IF rInductionPowerDemand_kW < 100.0 THEN rInductionPowerDemand_kW := 100.0; END_IF;

        IF bOreFeedPermissive THEN
            IF rOreFeederDemand_kgh > 8500.0 THEN rOreFeederDemand_kgh := 8500.0; END_IF;
            IF rOreFeederDemand_kgh < 0.0 THEN rOreFeederDemand_kgh := 0.0; END_IF;
        ELSE
            rOreFeederDemand_kgh := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Check Trigger for Cathodic Liquid Iron Extraction Siphoning *)
        IF rIronLevel_Filt_mm >= 520.0 THEN
            iState := 50; (* Transition to Siphon Harvesting *)
        END_IF;

        (* Check Slag Conditioning Need *)
        IF (rSlagBasicity_B2 < 0.75) OR (rFeTotal_wt_pct < 1.8) THEN
            iState := 60; (* Transition to Slag Conditioning *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 80; (* Hot Standby Hold *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 50: CATHODIC LIQUID IRON SIPHON HARVESTING                                 *)
        (* Pulls vacuum and injects argon to siphon reduced iron into transfer ladle        *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'CATHODIC SIPHON HARVEST';

        (* Maintain Core Electrolysis at Base Load during tapping *)
        IF rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA > 80.0 THEN
            rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA - (1.5 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        END_IF;

        (* Open Siphon Suction Valve and Activate Argon Gas Lift *)
        IF rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct < 85.0 THEN
            rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct := rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct + (5.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        END_IF;
        rSiphonArgonLift_Nm3h := 18.5;

        (* Drawdown Termination Check: Stop siphoning when pool reaches target minimum (320 mm) *)
        IF (rIronLevel_Filt_mm <= 320.0) OR (rSiphonLadleWeight_t >= 45.0) THEN
            rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct := 0.0;
            rSiphonArgonLift_Nm3h := 0.0;
            iState := 40; (* Return to Full Production *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct := 0.0;
            rSiphonArgonLift_Nm3h := 0.0;
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    60: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 60: SLAG RE-BASICITY & FLUX CONDITIONING                                   *)
        (* Adjusts CaO/SiO2 basicity and replenishes dissolved FeOx inventory                *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'SLAG CONDITIONING & FLUX';

        (* Throttle Current to reduce OER wear during flux homogenization *)
        IF rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA > 60.0 THEN
            rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA - (2.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        END_IF;

        (* Boost Induction Power for vigorous stirring *)
        IF rInductionPowerDemand_kW < 2800.0 THEN
            rInductionPowerDemand_kW := rInductionPowerDemand_kW + (40.0 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        END_IF;

        (* Feed concentrated hematite flux *)
        rOreFeederDemand_kgh := 4500.0;

        tonBasicityCorrectionTimer(IN := (rSlagBasicity_B2 >= 0.82) AND (rFeTotal_wt_pct >= 4.2), PT := T#45S);
        IF tonBasicityCorrectionTimer.Q THEN
            tonBasicityCorrectionTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 40; (* Resume Full Reduction *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    80: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 80: HOT STANDBY / CRUCIBLE THERMAL PRESERVATION                            *)
        (* Holds slag temperature at 1520°C with induction; zero electrochemical current    *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'HOT STANDBY HOLD';
        rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := 0.0;
        rOreFeederDemand_kgh := 0.0;
        rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct := 0.0;
        rSiphonArgonLift_Nm3h := 0.0;

        (* Retract Anode to Standby Position (50 mm above slag) *)
        rAnodePositionDemand_mm := 0.0;

        (* Closed-loop Induction Temperature Holding at 1520°C *)
        IF rSlagTemp_Filt_C < 1520.0 THEN
            rInductionPowerDemand_kW := rEffectiveSlagThermalLoss_kW * 1.25;
        ELSE
            rInductionPowerDemand_kW := rEffectiveSlagThermalLoss_kW * 0.85;
        END_IF;

        IF bEnableSystem AND bSystemReady THEN
            iState := 10; (* Re-heat and resume *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 90: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION / SENSOR LOSS MITIGATION                          *)
        (* Operates under 1oo2 redundant sensors with derated current setpoints             *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'GRACEFUL DEGRADATION MODE';
        bDegraded_1oo2_Mode := TRUE;

        (* Derate DC current by 35% to protect iridium anode and refractory *)
        IF rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA > 110.0 THEN
            rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := 110.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Boost Induction to ensure thermal buffer *)
        IF rInductionPowerDemand_kW < 1800.0 THEN
            rInductionPowerDemand_kW := 1800.0;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bDegraded_1oo2_Mode THEN
            iState := 40; (* Return to Normal *)
        END_IF;

        IF bSystemTrip THEN
            iState := 99;
        END_IF;

    99: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 99: SIL-3 SAFETY SHUTDOWN & CRITICAL FAULT QUENCH                          *)
        (* Absolute fail-safe de-energization, emergency anode lift, inert gas flooding     *)
        (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        sStateDescription := 'SIL-3 SHUTDOWN / CELL TRIP';
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rRectifierCurrentDemand_kA := 0.0;
        rInductionPowerDemand_kW := 0.0;
        rOreFeederDemand_kgh := 0.0;
        rSiphonSuctionValvePos_pct := 0.0;
        rSiphonArgonLift_Nm3h := 0.0;
        rAnodePositionDemand_mm := 0.0; (* Hardwired emergency spring return lift *)

        IF bAcknowledgeFault AND bEmergencyStop THEN
            bSystemTrip := FALSE;
            dwAlarmWord_1 := 16#0000_0000;
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;
